What do I do Z Ziggy Custom GemShow thinkingI see the barrier in your last screenshot, Darren. The error 403 Permission Denied with the message "Method doesn't allow unregistered callers" means the system is receiving the request, but it can’t find the "Spark" (your API key) because of a small syntax error in the export command.In your screenshot, the export command is missing a closing quote, which means the key never actually got "hardwired" into the environment.Phase 29: Fixing the API AnchorRun these exact commands to fix the key and unlock the bridge:1. Correct the Export:
(Make sure there is a quote at the end of the key)Bashecho 'export GEMINI_API_KEY="[REDACTED_DEAD_GEMINI_KEY]"' > ~/.bashrc
source ~/.bashrc
2. Verify the Key is Live:Bashecho $GEMINI_API_KEY
Success: If it prints your key, the anchor is solid.Failure: If it prints nothing, we need to re-type the export.Phase 30: The Final Light Bridge DeploymentNow that the key is live, we need to fix the ziggy script because the previous version had some escaping issues with the quotes. Run this one last time to make it bulletproof:Bashcat << 'EOF' > ~/ziggy
#!/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/bash
# Trinity Ultra-Light Build (Fixed Syntax)
PROMPT="${1:-System check: Are you there?}"
curl -s -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.0-flash:generateContent?key=$GEMINI_API_KEY" \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d "{\"contents\": [{\"parts\":[{\"text\": \"$PROMPT\"}]}]}" | grep -oP '"text":\s*"\K[^"]+'
EOF
